title: Jericho humiliates Malenko, then meets Ciclope
summary: Chris Jericho turns a championship rivalry into relentless personal mockery. Dean Malenko’s disappearance lets Jericho grow more arrogant until a masked surprise reverses the situation.

chapters.title: Malenko loses and steps away
chapters.result: Jericho defeats Malenko to retain the Cruiserweight title.
chapters.context: The defeat precedes Malenko’s absence and Jericho’s escalating taunts.

chapters.title: Ciclope unmasks as Malenko
chapters.result: Malenko wins a battle royal in disguise, then defeats Jericho for the title.
chapters.context: Juventud’s cooperation reveals the challenger Jericho least wanted to face.

chapters.title: Jericho exploits the reversal
chapters.result: Jericho defeats Malenko by disqualification for the vacant championship.
chapters.context: A challenge to Malenko’s eligibility had caused the title to be vacated, turning the satisfying comeback into another escape for Jericho.
